items.title: [HYBRID-HN] Senior Fullstack Developer (Python)
items.description:
We are seeking a highly capable Senior Developer with strong hands-on software development, problem-solving, communication, and client collaboration skills.
This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who can independently deliver high-quality solutions, contribute to technical discussions, work effectively with international clients, and support successful project delivery in an outsourcing environment.
The ideal candidate should have solid hands-on experience in Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with the ability to work across backend and frontend systems at Senior level.
**I. REQUIREMENTS**
• 5+ years of professional software development experience, including experience working at Senior Developer level
• Strong hands-on experience with Python and solid experience with JavaScript and TypeScript
• Strong experience in backend development and practical experience with modern frontend development
• Good understanding of software architecture, system design, object-oriented design, and scalable application development
• Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, or Vue
• Experience designing, developing, and integrating RESTful APIs
• Working knowledge of relational or NoSQL databases, automated
testing, Git, and code review practices
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills; able to
work independently on complex tasks
• Good English communication skills, able to discuss requirements
and technical solutions with international customers
• Strong teamwork, ownership, and time-management skills in Agile
delivery environments
   
• Experience working in outsourcing or multi-project environments is preferred
**Nice to Have:**
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices
• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized environments
• Experience with microservices architecture
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform
• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g.,
Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.)
• Experience working with high-scale or enterprise systems
• Ability to support pre-sales activities or technical proposal
discussions with customers
**II. BENEFITS & PERKS** 
1. Working Hours
• Check-in at 8:30 AM; no check-out required
• Working days: Monday to Friday; weekends (Saturday & Sunday) off
2. Exclusive Leave Policy
• 12 annual leave days per year; public holidays in accordance with Vietnamese labor law
• 01 additional company holiday (the second Monday of October every year)
3. Transparent Salary & Bonus Scheme
• Bonuses on company anniversary and Lunar New Year (Tet)
• Year-end performance bonus based on business results
4. Engaging & Collaborative Work Environment                          
 • Participation in major annual events: Year End Party, company summer trip, and celebrations such as International Women’s Day (March 8), International Men’s Day (November 19), etc.
• Exciting sports activities: Sports Day, E-sports tournaments, etc.
• Active internal clubs: Yoga Club, Football Club, etc.
• Modern open workspace with well-equipped facilities: Tatami
Room, Mother Room, Pantry, etc.
5. Strong Learning & Development Culture
• A wide range of free training programs covering both technical and soft skills
• Free in-depth offline Japanese language courses from N5 to N1, including direct conversation (kaiwa) with native Japanese teachers
• Free access to the Udemy online learning platform
• Financial support for exam preparation and certification, with
additional rewards for achieving advanced certifications
• Opportunities to become an internal trainer, with compensation
provided
• Participation in workshops, seminars, and networking opportunities
with leading experts in various fields
• Company Address: 4th Floor, Hoa Binh Building, 106 Hoang Quoc Viet Street, Hanoi, Vietnam
**III. CONTACT INFORMATION**
Recruitment Consultant- Ms. Thu: tranthilethu890@gmail.com
Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/in/thu-tran-1a8645165/

items.title: Open Source Contributor (GitHub)
items.description:
### Repository

Organization

### Company Name

Micro1

### Company URL

https://www.micro1.ai

### Career/Job Page URL

https://www.micro1.ai/careers

### Repository Description

We are looking for highly skilled Open-Source Software Engineers to contribute to an AI training project involving software development, repository exploration, debugging, system architecture, and code evaluation.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging software-engineering tasks across front-end and back-end systems and helping with translating full coding builds from one particular language into another.

We are particularly interested in engineers who own or maintain open-source repositories or have made meaningful contributions to established projects. Contributions should demonstrate real engineering ability, not only documentation updates, dependency bumps, formatting changes, or minor typo corrections.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific repositories, pull requests, issues, and code they personally authored.
What You’ll Work On
1.	Explore and understand unfamiliar software repositories.
2.	Implement, modify, and debug front-end and back-end components.
3.	Trace data and execution across interfaces, services, libraries, APIs, databases, and external dependencies.
4.	Reproduce software issues and identify their underlying causes.
5.	Implement solutions that fit an existing project’s architecture and contribution standards.
6.	Write unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests.
7.	Review AI-generated patches for correctness, completeness, security, and maintainability.

Required Qualifications
1.	A public or otherwise verifiable GitHub profile.
2.	Meaningful ownership of or contributions to one or more open-source repositories.
3.	Strong software-engineering experience across front-end, back-end, full-stack, systems, developer tooling, infrastructure, or another substantial technical area.
4.	Experience with multiple programming languages.
5.	Ability to understand and modify unfamiliar codebases.

Relevant languages may include TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, or other languages used in substantial open-source projects.

Process
1.	Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
2.	Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
3.	Complete the hiring manager review.
Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.
Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum number of tasks per week.
Use this link to apply:
https://jobs.micro1.ai/post/18a809aa-0b7f-4523-ac0e-508c9f0f6f66?referralCode=3ce564e4-9607-4f6f-8e80-063ee4434334&utm_source=referral&utm_medium=share&utm_campaign=job_referral


### Primary Language

software development, repository exploration, debugging, system architecture, and code evaluation.

- [x] I have verified that the career/job page URL is correct and active

items.title: [新加坡优先/任意城市] AI 自动化实习生（AI Agent 工作流方向）  日薪20-40USD-远程/混合办公
items.description:
地点： 新加坡优先/任意城市（远程 / 混合办公）
类型： 全职实习（工作日周一至周五9:00-18:00），建议 6 个月（最少 4 个月） 汇报对象： 产品负责人　
岗位介绍：
团队中有大量日常工作已经标准化，步骤、输入和输出都是确定的。你将直接与产品负责人合作，找出这些工作，把它们做成熟稳定运行的 AI Agent 工作流，并交付团队日常使用。
工作职责：
梳理流程，与同事沟通，记录现有工作的输入、步骤、判断规则和异常情况，评估哪些环节可以交给 AI，哪些需要人工把关。
搭建 Agent，使用 Claude Code、大模型 API、MCP、Python / TypeScript 脚本，以及 n8n / Dify 等工具实现自动化工作流，并对接 Google Workspace、Slack / Lark、Notion、数据 API 等系统。
测试与上线，用历史真实案例构建测试集，对比 AI 与人工的输出质量，设置人工审核节点；上线后负责定时调度、日志、报错和成本监控。
文档与维护，为每个工作流编写使用和维护说明，确保他人可以接手。
安全合规：遵守 API Key、账号和内部数据的权限管理规定。
任职要求：
计算机、工程、数据等相关专业在读或应届毕业，或具备同等实践经验；
用大模型 API 或 AI 编程工具做过至少一个可运行的项目（Agent、自动化脚本或工具均可）申请时需提供作品链接；
掌握 Python 或 JavaScript / TypeScript 基础，熟悉 API、JSON、Git 和命令行；
能把模糊的任务拆解成清晰的步骤，并写出他人看得懂的文档；
英文书面沟通良好；[如需要] 能使用中文工作，岗位需要与中文团队协作并处理中文资料；
主动负责：自己测试交付物，发现问题及时提出。
加分项： 用过 Claude Code（skills / subagents）、MCP 或多 Agent 框架；熟悉 RAG 或大模型效果评估；了解 Linux / Docker；对加密货币或金融市场有兴趣。
我们提供：
产品负责人直接带教，做出的工作流投入真实使用
公司报销AI 模型和工具费用

申请方式：
请将以下材料发送至 [hr@sosovalue.com]：
① 简历；② GitHub、作品集或 Demo 链接；③ 200 字以内的简述：你用 AI 自动化过的一项工作，包括它做了什么、怎么实现的，以及遇到过什么问题。 通过初筛后安排约 3 小时的小作业和面试。
联系方式：
TG：@fernnini
微信：Lforngift

items.title: [Híbrido -SP] Back-end developer Cobol Boleto e Cobrança - Evertec
items.description:
### Nossa empresa
Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec!

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.

### Descrição da vaga

Atuação em squad responsável pela implementação de demandas regulatórias relacionadas ao Split Payment, com foco nos produtos de Boletos e Cobrança. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções críticas em ambiente Mainframe, garantindo conformidade regulatória, qualidade e estabilidade dos processos.

### Local
Posição híbrida, com atuação presencial 2 vezes por semana em Interlagos, São Paulo/SP.

### Requisitos
Responsabilidades

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações em ambiente Mainframe.
- Implementar requisitos regulatórios relacionados aos produtos de Boletos e Cobrança.
- Desenvolver e realizar manutenção em programas COBOL, transações CICS e rotinas batch.
- Atuar na análise técnica e implementação de melhorias sistêmicas.
- Desenvolver integrações entre sistemas envolvidos nos processos de cobrança.
- Realizar testes unitários e apoiar homologações.
- Participar das cerimônias ágeis e colaborar com o time na definição de soluções técnicas.
- Requisitos Obrigatórios
- Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em COBOL.
- Conhecimento em CICS.
- Experiência em JCL.
- Conhecimento em DB2.
- Vivência em ambiente Mainframe z/OS.
- Experiência com análise técnica e desenvolvimento de sistemas transacionais.
- Atuação em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

### Diferenciais

- Experiência em projetos regulatórios.
- Conhecimento em processos de Boletos Bancários e Cobrança.
- Experiência no segmento financeiro ou bancário.
- Conhecimento de liquidação financeira, arrecadação e recebimentos.
- Vivência em sistemas de alta disponibilidade e processamento de grande volume transacional.

### Benefícios
E ai, se identificou com o que leu até agora? Então, vou te contar o que você encontrará aqui, além de um ambiente dinâmico:

• Vale refeição ou alimentação;
• Benefício Flexível (Flash);
• Assistência médica;
• Parceiros para atendimento psicológico, jurídico, financeiro e nutricional (CLUDE, C4LIFE E ASQ);
• Psicologia Viva;
• Assistência Odontológica;
• Auxílio creche;
• Auxílio para filhos com necessidades especiais;
• Auxílio fertilização;
• Extensão Licença Maternidade e Paternidade;
• Vale transporte ou Auxílio Home Office (para contrato teletrabalho);
• Gympass (Wellhub) e TotalPass;
• Horários flexíveis;
• Seguro de vida;
• Clube de parcerias;
• Parceria com Sesc;
• Just dress no code (sem código de vestimenta);
• Day off no aniversário;
• Beca (programa de incentivo a educação);
• PPR ou Bônus - conforme atingimento de metas e resultados.

### Contratação
CLT

### Como se candidatar
Gostou da vaga? Se candidate no link: [Profissional Mainframe (COBOL) - BOLETO E COBRANÇA](https://jobs.quickin.io/sinqia/jobs/6a89a2b8c007c80013336657)

Está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Cobol Sênior para atuar na evolução do PIX Orquestrador, plataforma estratégica responsável pela integração e orquestração das jornadas de pagamento do banco, apoiando as iniciativas regulatórias relacionadas ao Split Payment no contexto da Reforma Tributária.

O profissional participará da adaptação de fluxos transacionais críticos, garantindo que os sistemas core estejam preparados para suportar os novos modelos de arrecadação, retenção e liquidação financeira exigidos pela regulamentação, mantendo altos padrões de disponibilidade, segurança e performance.


**Local**

- Garantir a qualidade e a confiabilidade dos processos de pagamento e liquidação.
- Apoiar testes integrados, homologações e implantações em produção.
- Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes em ambientes críticos.
- Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de Produtos, Arquitetura, Negócios e Compliance.

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Cobol Mainframe.
- Conhecimento em CICS, DB2, JCL e VSAM.
- Experiência em sistemas transacionais de alta disponibilidade.
- Vivência em processamento de pagamentos ou sistemas financeiros críticos.
- Conhecimento em análise e modelagem de dados.
- Experiência em manutenção evolutiva e corretiva de sistemas core.
- Atuação em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

items.title: [招聘] Senior Solidity Smart Contract Engineer｜Remote｜$15,000–$18,000/月
items.description:
## 公司/团队介绍

**BitAngels** 是一家总部位于美国的区块链投资集团，长期关注 Web3、区块链基础设施及去中心化项目。

我们目前正在支持一个基于 **Ethereum** 的去中心化 Governance & Staking 项目，现招聘一名资深 Solidity 工程师参与核心协议开发。

项目已有 MVP，目前进入进一步产品和协议开发阶段。我们希望找到一位有实际生产环境经验、能够参与技术方案和架构决策的工程师。

**公司官网：** https://bitangels.us/
**联系邮箱：** dylan.reed@bitangels.us

## 薪资福利待遇

* **$15,000–$18,000 USD / 月**
* Full-time / Part-time 均可
* Remote 工作
* 直接与项目及工程团队合作
* 参与核心协议设计和技术决策

## 地点

* **工作地点：** Remote，欢迎中国大陆及香港候选人
* **联系方式：**

  * Hiring Manager：Dylan Reed
  * Email：dylan.reed@bitangels.us
  * Telegram：@Web3HiringTalents

## 工作性质

* **是否全职：** Full-time / Part-time 均可
* **是否远程：** 是
* **时区要求：** 以 GMT+8 为主，可覆盖核心工作时间，并能够适应国际分布式团队协作
* **沟通语言：** 日常沟通以英文为主，能够进行基本的英文工作沟通即可，技术交流可结合文字沟通。

## 岗位要求、职责

### 主要职责

* 使用 Solidity 开发和维护 Ethereum / EVM 智能合约
* 负责 Staking、Governance 等核心协议功能开发
* 参与智能合约架构和技术方案设计
* 进行代码 Review、安全性检查及 Gas 优化
* 编写测试并协助智能合约部署
* 与产品及工程团队共同推进协议开发和迭代

### 岗位要求

* 扎实的 Solidity 和 Ethereum / EVM 开发经验
* 有生产环境智能合约开发及部署经验
* 熟悉 DeFi、Staking、Governance、Token 等机制
* 了解常见 Smart Contract Security 问题
* 熟悉 Foundry、Hardhat 等开发及测试工具
* 能够独立负责核心模块，并参与技术决策
* 具备良好的英文技术沟通能力

**有 DAO、Governance、Staking 协议开发或 Smart Contract Security / Audit 经验者优先。**

## 工作环境

我们是一个国际化、远程协作的 Web3 团队，团队成员分布在不同地区。

这个岗位并不是单纯按照既定需求开发。我们希望工程师能够参与协议设计、技术讨论以及产品早期阶段的决策，并对核心智能合约负责。

如果你对这个机会感兴趣，欢迎直接联系：

**Hiring Manager：Dylan Reed**
**Email：dylan.reed@bitangels.us**
**Telegram：@Web3HiringTalents**

申请时请附上：

* CV / 简历
* GitHub 或相关项目
* Solidity / Web3 开发经历
* 当前可投入时间（Full-time / Part-time）

我们会先简单了解你的背景和相关经验。如果双方初步匹配，我们会进一步介绍项目和技术方向，并安排线上交流，详细了解彼此以及岗位情况。

items.title: [Hiring] Senior Solidity Smart Contract Engineer | Remote | $15K–$18K/month
items.description:
## Company/Team Introduction

**BitAngels** is a US-based blockchain investment group with a long-standing focus on Web3, blockchain infrastructure, and decentralized projects.

We are currently supporting an **Ethereum**-based decentralized governance and staking project and are seeking a Senior Solidity Engineer to participate in core protocol development.

The project already has an MVP and is entering the phase of further product and protocol development. We are looking for an engineer with practical production-environment experience who can contribute to technical solutions and architectural decisions.

**Company Website:** https://bitangels.us/
**Contact Email:** dylan.reed@bitangels.us

## Compensation & Benefits

* **$15,000–$18,000 USD / month**
* Full-time or Part-time options available
* Remote work
* Work directly with the project and engineering teams
* Participate in core protocol design and technical decision-making

## Location

* **Work Location:** Remote; candidates from Mainland China and Hong Kong are welcome
* **Contact Information:**

* Hiring Manager: Dylan Reed
* Email: dylan.reed@bitangels.us
* Telegram: @Web3HiringTalents

## Job Details

* **Employment Type:** Full-time or Part-time
* **Remote:** Yes
* **Time Zone Requirement:** Primarily GMT+8; must cover core working hours and adapt to collaboration within an international distributed team
* **Communication Language:** English is the primary language for daily communication (basic professional English proficiency required); technical discussions can be supplemented with written communication. ## Role Requirements & Responsibilities

### Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain Ethereum/EVM smart contracts using Solidity
* Lead the development of core protocol features such as Staking and Governance
* Participate in smart contract architecture and technical design
* Conduct code reviews, security audits, and gas optimization
* Write tests and assist with smart contract deployment
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive protocol development and iteration

### Requirements

* Solid experience in Solidity and Ethereum/EVM development
* Proven experience developing and deploying smart contracts in production environments
* Familiarity with DeFi, Staking, Governance, and Token mechanisms
* Understanding of common smart contract security vulnerabilities
* Proficiency with development and testing tools such as Foundry and Hardhat
* Ability to independently own core modules and participate in technical decision-making
* Strong English technical communication skills

**Experience with DAO, Governance, or Staking protocol development, or smart contract security/auditing, is a plus.**

## Work Environment

We are an international, remote-first Web3 team with members distributed across various regions.

This role goes beyond simply building to pre-defined specifications. We look for engineers who can actively participate in protocol design, technical discussions, and early-stage product decision-making, while taking ownership of core smart contracts.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please contact us directly:

**Hiring Manager: Dylan Reed**
**Email: dylan.reed@bitangels.us**
**Telegram: @Web3HiringTalents**

Please include the following when applying:

* CV / Resume
* GitHub profile or relevant projects
* Solidity / Web3 development experience
* Current availability (Full-time / Part-time)

We will first review your background and experience. If there is a preliminary match, we will provide more details about the project and technical direction, and schedule an online call to discuss the role and get to know each other better.

items.title: Australian marketplace startup - Senior Software Engineer (React / Full-Stack) - Remote/Vietnam - FT
items.description:
## Location

* Remote / Vietnam (distributed team across Australia and Vietnam)

## Salary Expectation

* Competitive (negotiable based on experience)

## Requirements

* 5+ years of professional software development experience
* Experience designing and building full-stack features end-to-end (UI through backend integration)
* Backend development and API design (REST/gRPC)
* Relational databases and data modelling
* Cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and containerisation
* CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices
* Strong written/spoken English for distributed, async-first collaboration

## Skills

### Must Have

* React Strength track: React, TypeScript, modern build tools (Webpack, Babel), state management (TanStack or similar)
* Full-Stack Generalist track: React / React Native plus work across Rails, Kotlin, and Golang services
* Comfort working across multiple programming languages and stacks
* Writing comprehensive tests within strong CI/CD practices
* Applying AI tooling effectively in day-to-day engineering

### Ideally

* User analytics and data transformation pipelines
* Prior work in marketplace / consumer product environments
* Experience migrating legacy systems to modern architecture patterns

### Responsibilities

Own full-stack product features on the Product Engineering team across two related senior tracks (React Strength and Full-Stack Generalist).

### You’ll be responsible for

* Designing and building full-stack features across the React/TypeScript (and React Native) frontend and Kotlin / Go / Rails backends
* Implementing robust API integrations following BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns
* Building responsive, accessible user interfaces using the design system
* Writing tests and contributing to CI/CD, observability, monitoring, and on-call
* Mentoring teammates and raising engineering standards
* Judging when a complex solution is warranted vs when a simpler one ships reliably

### You can bring

* Strong product thinking and attention to craft
* Ownership and autonomy in a distributed, async-first environment
* A consistent focus on user experience and technical quality

### Why it would be awesome to work with us

* Own features end-to-end on a real marketplace product, not slice-only tickets
* Modern frontend plus a multi-language microservices ecosystem (Golang, Rails, Kotlin)
* Distributed team across Australia, Portugal, and Vietnam
* Culture that prefers the simplest solution that gets the job done

### What's the roadmap is like for the near future.
* Ongoing migration from legacy systems to modern architecture patterns. Heavily AI-assisted SLDC (Claude account provided)
* BFF-based API integration across a multi-language backend
* Design-system-driven UI shared across web (and mobile for the Generalist track)

### Contact
SMS / WhatsApp: 0583362116
